text: Replaced the local VolumeDomain implementation with a checked image4s-locus GridDomain bridge using canonical row-major-last-axis-fastest/v1 ordinals and an explicit certified bijection to legacy first-axis-fastest/v1 indexing. Persistent grid identity is content-derived from exact shape plus raw affine bits; semantic atlas/dataset labels no longer define voxel identity. Added language-neutral versioned ordinal records, same-sized foreign-grid and unknown-layout rejection, asymmetric 2x3x5 mapping oracle and round-trip/law tests, and updated image, dataset, threshold, MVPA-spatial, atlas reducers, and atlas graph boundaries. Evidence: scalafimCompileAll green; image, dataset, surface, threshold, mvpaSpatial, atlas, archivedResponseInterop, datasetZarr, archive, and archiveZarr suites green on JVM and Scala.js; git diff --check clean.
